title: Personal agent flow
lede: Sam asks Muse. The gateway answers 401, so Muse asks PingOne for a token. PingOne signs Sam in and calls Protect through DaVinci. If it is not Muse, PingOne assumes a person. If it is Muse, Sam is asked to consent. Then the call is retried: the gateway checks the tool and the call. Everything here is simulated.

nodes.label: Protect
sub: Muse or a person? DaVinci flow (simulated)

nodes.label: Consent
sub: Muse only: "this is a bot, allow it?"

nodes.label: Coarse check
sub: Which personas may call the tool

steps.title: Sam asks Muse
steps.what: Muse takes the request from Sam's signed-in session.

steps.title: Muse calls the gateway
steps.what: Muse calls the tool through the gateway with no token yet.

steps.title: 401: authorize
steps.what: The gateway answers 401. Muse sends an authorization request to PingOne.

steps.title: Login and Protect
steps.what: PingOne has Sam signed in, then its DaVinci flow calls Protect to detect whether the caller is Muse. If it is not Muse, PingOne assumes a person and issues the token.

steps.title: Consent (Muse only)
steps.what: Muse is a bot, so Sam sees a modal asking whether to allow it to act on their behalf. A person skips this step.

steps.title: Retry: coarse check
steps.what: With a token, the gateway retries. Muse-detect looks for bursts and hidden instructions, then Privilege asks whether this persona may call the tool at all.

steps.title: Fine check
steps.what: Privilege applies the business rule to this call. Over the limit, the call is held until a person approves it.

steps.title: Resource
steps.what: The call is allowed, so the tool runs.
